audience: workforce planners and operations managers who review organization and staffing records in Quinyx

useCases.title: Explore organization groups and units
useCases.text: Review organization groups, including units and sections, then open a selected group to inspect its operational metadata.

useCases.title: Review employee role assignments
useCases.text: Review scheduling employee details, organization roles and employee role assignments together before a staffing discussion.

useCases.title: Review planned shifts for a unit
useCases.text: Identify the unit and review its planned shifts for a defined period. Shift reads cover at most 93 days per request.

useCases.title: Review employee agreement metadata
useCases.text: Review agreement scheduling metadata and open a selected agreement alongside the employee record, without returning payroll or private fields.
